name: city_detail_presence_and_object_types
description: CD4: the presence test of the increase pass's step 3 counts only flora and prop occupants, by their lot tag alone. Lot 0x10 lists required prop A, required flora F, required prop C, an object of type 2 with ID B and a required prop B. A building tagged A is ignored, so A is still needed; a prop tagged F satisfies the flora object F and a flora occupant tagged C satisfies the prop object C. Step 4 then places and draws for every object whose ID is needed, whatever its type: A (prop, created), the type-2 object (drawn for, creates nothing) and prop B (created, ID B being needed through prop B).
